0x000968.en: 「With what I've got now...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x0009D9.en: 「Guh!@ So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000A61.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000B8A.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000BC2.en: 「Uh-oh...@ Not my finest hour, that's for sure!」

0x000C36.en: 「Nngh, so this is where it ends!」

0x000CC6.en: 「No way I'm screwing up here...!@ This is no fun...」

0x000D1A.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000D8E.en: 「Guh! Nothing to do but fall back!!」

0x000E6B.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is on you.」

0x000E9D.en: 「Damn it...!@ Is this where it ends!」

0x000ED9.en: 「Nngh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000F17.en: 「No good, we've taken too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000F64.en: 「Well, that's a shame. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000FA2.en: 「Eek! The rest is up to you!」

0x000FE9.en: 「To think... the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x001094.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x001113.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x0011D0.en: 「Ngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x00123D.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001284.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0012B9.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0013A5.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0013F3.en: 「No good, this is my limit! Retreating!」

0x0014AE.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00151B.en: 「Well, well. So this is as far as I go.」

0x00154A.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x0015D5.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back here...!」

0x00173B.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Not a graceful exit, is it...」

0x0017F9.en: 「Guuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001AB3.en: 「Well now, I can finally get off this ship.」

0x001B03.en: 「Once the Hiryu surfaces, our Excellence will@ carry everyone to the coast.」

0x001C16.en: 「Eh, I've got more contacts in Mexico than in Lima anyway...@ And the Ruina haven't shown up there, right?」

0x001CAF.en: 「I'll send you the bill for everything once things settle down.@ With the Ruina and aliens running wild,@ there's no doing business anyway.」

0x001D89.en: 「I... I'd like to stay on this ship.」

0x001DC6.en: 「Come on now,@ even if you've got <AM> battling experience,@ I'm not hiring for a sidekick-of-justice gig, you know?」

0x001E67.en: 「Seeing the people on this ship fighting@ to save Earth from danger, I wanted to help too...」

0x001EEA.en: 「I thought maybe here I could find@ what I really want to do...」

0x001F64.en: 「This is a warship... and right now, we're fugitives.@ You might not be able to turn back.」

0x002003.en: 「Even so,@ is there any work for you on this ship?」

0x002056.en: 「We've got civilian helpers like Kouta and Fiona, but...@ they're the exception to the exception.」

0x0020C7.en: 「Touma, if you're serious about working...@ I'll hire you at my company.」

0x00214E.en: 「In exchange, you're on odd jobs for a while. Since@ you're with the Steel Dragon Squadron, there's@ limits on what you can do. That okay?」

0x002274.en: 「...I don't want to get off this ship...」

0x0022CE.en: 「The Hiryu is a warship. If you stay aboard,@ you'll get caught up in the fighting again.」

0x002348.en: 「You're safer with Mr. Ruslan.@ Besides, he'll search for your family...」

0x0023DE.en: （She has no memory of her past...@ It's only natural she'd feel anxious...）

0x002440.en: 「Tsugumi...@ if this child wants to, couldn't she stay with us...」

0x00249C.en: 「...No, Ibis. Have you forgotten we're being@ hunted by the Federation Army and the Gaia Sabers@ right now?」

0x00254E.en: 「Listen, Irui.@ If you're with Mr. Ruslan, we can see each other again.」

0x0025C0.en: 「...I'll come see you for sure, Irui... I promise.@ So please...」

0x002638.en: 「Say, Tsugumi.@ Can I take Irui in the Altairlion to see her off?」

0x0026B0.en: 「Carla and Kouta will be along too,@ so I think it'll be fine...」

0x002731.en: 「Mr. Ruslan, we'll reach the coast in about five minutes.」

0x002774.en: 「Got it.@ Still... it's quite comfortable,@ this Excellence Rescue.」

0x0027E0.en: 「This rescue pod doubling as a cabin@ has amenities on par with an RV.」

0x00285B.en: 「Yes. With about three aboard,@ you could spend several days in here.」

0x0028BD.en: 「Raji even slacks off in here sometimes.」

0x00291A.en: 「How rude.@ I use it when I want to focus@ on work alone.」

0x00297D.en: 「Might make a good camping pod if we based one on this.@ It could sell well.」

0x0029E2.en: 「In that case,@ leave the design to our Mizuho Saiki.@ She does good work.」

0x002A57.en: 「Hey, hey, hey, if you really make it,@ can you let me be the one to test it?」

0x002B0F.en: 「If you want to enjoy a date with your sweetheart,@ someone's got to deal with the Ruina's dimensional rift first.」

0x002B8F.en: 「I know, Mr. Ruslan.@ I'll do my best.」

0x002BDF.en: 「Counting on you, Carla.@ I'm starting to miss the sunlight.」

0x002C44.en: 「...Irui, how's the ride in the Altairlion?」

0x002C8A.en: 「Don't make that face.@ I told you, didn't I? If you're with Mr. Ruslan,@ we can meet again.」

0x002D05.en: 「...Hey, Irui.@ Want to fly a little longer in the Altairlion?」

0x002D7D.en: 「Raul, mind if we take a little detour?」

0x002DEB.en: 「Just flying around here a bit.@ You all go ahead. I won't keep you waiting.」

0x002E8B.en: 「Ibis, are you... looking out for Irui?」

0x002ED1.en: 「All right, just for a little while.」

0x002EF6.en: 「Just one Altairlion has me worried.@ Should I come along too?」

0x002F49.en: 「No.@ We'll just U-turn and come right back, so it's fine.」

0x003048.en: 「I really wish we could've flown under a starry sky.」

0x0030A4.en: 「Right. My dream is to fly this Altairlion@ across a sea of stars.」

0x003128.en: 「Someday I'll make it come true, for sure...」

0x00315F.en: 「Ibis... I'm glad I got to fly with you.@　Thank you.」

0x0031B2.en: 「Same here.@　Being with you was fun, Irui.」

0x00322A.en: 「I came out to gather data against the Ruina, but...@　looks like I've hooked some interesting prey.」

0x003298.en: 「Though for you, I'd call it good fortune.」

0x003337.en: 「I'd rather not use this Psylion outside of@　the Ruina fight, but... for me,@　this will be my final mission.」

0x00340D.en: 「That unit's not in our data... a new model!?」

0x003472.en: 「It's okay, Irui. Everyone came for us.」

0x0034DE.en: 「Ho, the Steel Dragon Squadron's flagship shows itself.@　If it's them, there'll be no trouble.@　Let me confirm.」

0x003581.en: 「Yes, the group targeting new and upgraded units.@　Engaging us seems to be their aim,@　so the odds they'll strike are high.」

0x00362C.en: 「And on their side is Vegalion...@　Sleigh Presty as well.」

0x00368E.en: 「But I want to avoid combat if at all possible.@ First, let the Altairlion return to the ship.」

0x003711.en: 「Ibis, now's your chance!@　Get back quick and drop Irui off!」

0x00381C.en: 「A pendant...?@　Take it, you say... isn't it precious to you?」

0x00387B.en: 「It's fine...@　because I want you to have it, Ibis...」

0x0038CE.en: 「It's a charm...@　so you can fly the sea of stars...@　so your dream comes true...」

0x00395C.en: 「Thank you, Irui. I'll treasure the pendant.」

0x0039A5.en: 「This is the Steel Dragon Squadron commander,@　Colonel Lefina Enfield.@　We have no intention of engaging.」

0x003A35.en: 「Heh, what would a mere rebel know.@　All units, commence attack.」

0x003ABF.en: 「They're being hunted by the Federation and the@ Gaia Sabers now. We got the green light.」

0x003B39.en: 「This is a bonus.@ It sets an example for the Gaia Sabers too.@ You've got someone you want to settle things with, right?」

0x003BEE.en: 「Heh... well, fine.@　This time, the mission and your personal matters align.」

0x003C8C.en: 「Seems they've no ear to listen with.」

0x003CCC.en: 「We've no choice, we fight back!@　All units, sortie at once!」

0x003D1F.en: 「Raul, what about Ruslan and the others?」

0x003D4D.en: 「Don't worry, I dropped them off safely.」

0x003DB2.en: 「Sleigh!@　Even you must understand what kind of time this is!@　There's no meaning in us fighting!」
